content.content:
Entries shown on the page (newest first). Only 2025 entries include quotes, and each quote is under 125 characters.

1. **May 1, 2025: Linear MCP server**
   https://linear.app/changelog/2025-05-01-mcp
   - "Your AI models and agents can use our official MCP server to access your Linear data in a simple and secure way."
   - "so the server is centrally hosted and managed"

2. **April 30, 2025: Customer Requests on projects**
   https://linear.app/changelog/2025-04-30-customer-requests-on-projects
   - No API, GraphQL, MCP, webhook, SDK, OAuth, or agent-related bullets.

3. **April 16, 2025: Introducing Pulse, your personalized feed for what's happening across your company**
   https://linear.app/changelog/2025-04-16-pulse
   - "Removed the ability to convert a regular label into a group label by setting it as the `parentId` on another label."

4. **April 10, 2025: New search**
   https://linear.app/changelog/2025-04-10-new-search
   - "Personal API keys now support fine-grained permission controls."
   - "OAuth applications from the same workspace no longer require approval"
   - "Added support for PKCE flow for OAuth authentication without a client secret"
   - "`active` should be replaced with `userSuspend`/`userUnsuspend` mutations."
   - "Fixed updating issues that have a parent issue in a team pending deletion"

5. **April 3, 2025: Collapsed issue history**
   https://linear.app/changelog/2025-04-03-collapsed-issue-history
   - "The `iconUrl` provided when creating an issue attachment through the API is now properly displayed on the attachment"
   - "Fixed a bug where the owner of an OAuth integration was not notified when an issue was moved to Triage"

6. **March 19, 2025: Collapsible sections**
   https://linear.app/changelog/2025-03-19-collapsible-sections
   - No API, GraphQL, MCP, webhook, SDK, OAuth, or agent-related bullets.

7. **March 6, 2025: Sub-teams**
   https://linear.app/changelog/2025-03-06-sub-teams
   - "It is now possible to upsert customers with a tier by specifying the tier name instead of the tier UUID"
   - "Webhooks are now sent for initiatives and initiative updates"
   - "It is now possible to load a customer by its slug ID"

8. **February 13, 2025: Initiative updates**
   https://linear.app/changelog/2025-02-13-initiative-updates
   - "Fixed a crash when retrieving comments for some projects"
   - "It is now possible to use filters in the paginated `initiatives` query"
   - "Added `relations` and `inverseRelations` fields for Project dependencies in `Project`"
   - "It is now possible for webhooks to subscribe to updates of `Customer` and `CustomerNeed` entities"
   - "We now include the issue’s identifier and URL in the webhook payload"
   - "You can now filter for invited users in `UserFilter`"
   - "Added details of rate limits for requests that are rate-limited due to a specific mutation"
   - "It’s possible to query `projectUpdate.isStale` to identify whether the update is outdated or not"

9. **January 23, 2025: Pull Request reviews (alpha)**
   https://linear.app/changelog/2025-01-23-pull-request-reviews
   - "Made the integration managing a customer available through the field `integration` on `Customer`"
   - "Introduced a new String comparator `containsIgnoreCaseAndAccent` that matches text ignoring both case and accents"
   - "Removed `message` from `OrganizationInviteCreateInput`"
   - "Removed deprecated ProjectLink resolver"
   - "Removed deprecated `Document.contentData` and `ProjectMilestone.descriptionData` GraphQL fields."
   - "Added `addedLabelIds` and `removedLabelIds` in `IssueUpdateInput` to atomically add or remove label IDs for an issue"
   - "Fixed an issue where we allowed guests to install OAuth applications"

10. **December 18, 2024: Personalized sidebar and new settings pages**
    https://linear.app/changelog/2024-12-18-personalized-sidebar
    - Not a 2025 entry, so no quotes are included.

The page content was truncated, and it links to older updates at https://linear.app/changelog/page/7. Entries beyond the ones listed above are not covered.

**Linear changelog entries (as shown on the page)**

**1. December 4, 2025: "OpenAI Codex agent"**
https://linear.app/changelog/2025-12-04-openai-codex-agent
- Agents: "Archiving an agent’s only session on an issue will remove that agent as delegated"
- Agents: "Links to agent sessions now unfurl properly in Slack"
- Fix (Agents): "Fixed the agent session event webhooks payload stripping image attachments"
- Fix (Webhooks): "Fixed a bug where if an app user was added to a team that was later changed to private…"
- API: "`issueUpdate` is now allowed with the `issues:create` scope"
- API: "The `includeSubTeams` on `updates` now works even for custom views with no team ID defined"
- API: "We now expose all changes to an issue’s workflow state through the `Issue.stateHistory` field"
- API: "Added the ability to create a project from a template via API"
- Webhooks: "Added support for `ProjectLabel` webhook updates"

The same entry also covers "Workspace owners" and "Initiatives in Google Sheets," which have no separate URLs.

**2. November 20, 2025: "Form templates"**
https://linear.app/changelog/2025-11-20-form-templates
- MCP (in Figma Make section): "All tools supported by Linear’s MCP server are accessible in the connector."
- API: "`includeSubTeams` on `updates` now works even for custom views with no team ID defined"
- Fix (Webhooks): "Fixed a bug where if an app user was added to a team that was later changed to private…"
- Fix (Webhooks): "Fixed stripped attachments in agent session event webhook payloads"

**3. November 13, 2025: "Pulse on mobile"**
https://linear.app/changelog/2025-11-13-pulse-on-mobile
- Improvement (Security): "Added a security setting to control who can modify workspace-level agent guidance prompts"

This entry also includes "Updated Progress Graphs" and "Datadog integration" sections, which have no matching bullets.

**4. October 28, 2025: "GitHub Copilot agent"**
https://linear.app/changelog/2025-10-28-github-copilot-agent
- No API, GraphQL, MCP, webhook, SDK, OAuth, or agent-related bullets appear in the improvements or fixes. The body text describes the GitHub Copilot agent integration.

**5. October 23, 2025: "Linear agent for Slack"**
https://linear.app/changelog/2025-10-23-linear-agent-for-slack
- Improvement (Agents): "Improved agent action activities, which are now collapsed by default"
- Fix (MCP): "Fixed an argument validation error when a team name is provided instead of a team ID when filtering issue labels"

**6. October 16, 2025: "Mobile app redesign"**
https://linear.app/changelog/2025-10-16-mobile-app-redesign
- Factory agent section: "Users of Factory AI coding agents can now access them directly within Linear."
- Improvement (Sentry): "Improved the issue creation process with the Sentry integration, allowing agents with access…"
- Improvement (Webhooks): "OAuth apps can now subscribe to webhooks for when users authorize their app or revoke tokens for their app"
- Fix (Agents): "Agent sessions will no longer be deleted when an associated comment or issue is deleted"

**7. October 9, 2025: "Label descriptions and archiving"**
https://linear.app/changelog/2025-10-09-label-descriptions-and-archiving
- No API, GraphQL, MCP, webhook, SDK, OAuth, or agent-related bullets appear in the improvements or fixes.

**8. October 2, 2025: "Issue discussion summaries"**
https://linear.app/changelog/2025-10-02-issue-discussion-summaries
- Sentry Agent section: "Use the Sentry Agent to run a root cause analysis on any Linear issue linked to Sentry."
- Improvement (OAuth): "Improved support for upgrading scopes for an existing `app` token during the authorization code flow…"
- Improvement (OAuth): "Application approval requests that were previously denied can now be cleared…"
- Improvement (OAuth): "In workspaces with OAuth app approvals, users can now request approval for additional scopes…"
- Fix (OAuth): "Fixed an issue where `initiative:read`, `initative:write`, `customer:read`, and `customer:write` scopes…"
- MCP: "The `get_user` tool now supports searching for "me" or "current_user""

**9. September 18, 2025: "New to Product Intelligence: Auto-apply triage suggestions"**
https://linear.app/changelog/2025-09-19-auto-apply-triage-suggestions
(The page heading is dated September 18, but the URL contains 2025-09-19.)
- OAuth section: "We’re moving OAuth apps to use short-lived access tokens for user-initiated OAuth."
- OAuth section: "Starting October 1st, 2025, all newly created OAuth apps will issue refresh tokens by default."
- OAuth section: "We also added support for the `client_credentials` grant type for apps that use OAuth tokens…"
- Fix (Agents): "We now create an agent session if an agent is mentioned in an issue description, not just a comment"
- Fix (Agents): "Fixed agent panel so it closes on Esc when the input is empty"
- Fix (Agents): "The elicitation status badge in a comment is now removed when there is new activity"
- Fix (Sentry): "The Sentry integration now delegates to agents when choosing an agent as an assignee"
- Improvement (MCP): "Improved support for passing an API key or OAuth token received from an existing Linear integration"
- MCP: "Added support for querying and setting project state and members"
- API: "Removed an agent-delegation backwards-compatibility shim for API and webhooks…"
- API: "Added a new `semanticSearch` query that can search multiple item types at once"
- API: "Allowed issue:create tokens to access issueSubscribe and issueUnsubscribe"
- API: "Improved the process of creating a developer token for an app user with the option to choose which scopes to grant"

**10. September 4, 2025: "Salesforce integration"**
https://linear.app/changelog/2025-09-04-salesforce
- Improvement (Agents): "An agent session will now be created when an issue is delegated to an agent…"
- Improvement (iOS): "Improved visibility of workspace-level agents in the assignee picker"
- Improvement (Mobile): "When an agent replies in a thread, we now show their status in the inbox on mobile apps"
- Improvement (OAuth): "Updating an OAuth application’s avatar will now propagate to all app users associated with the application"
- Fix (PR reviews): "Fixed issue where, when a PR is open and a review is automatically requested from bots…"
- API: "Added `userEmail` as an optional input for `issueSubscribe` and `issueUnsubscribe`"
- API: "Improved response to return a 401 error rather than a 400 for an unauthenticated API request"
- API: "Fixed a bug to include issue in the response payload for `issueAddLabel` and `issueRemoveLabel`"

The page ends with an "Older updates" link, so entries before September 4, 2025 are not included here.

- Fix (OAuth): "Fixed an issue where `initiative:read`, `initative:write`, `customer:read`, and `customer:write` scopes…"
- MCP: "The `get_user` tool now supports searching for "me" or "current_user""

**9. September 18, 2025: "New to Product Intelligence: Auto-apply triage suggestions"**
https://linear.app/changelog/2025-09-19-auto-apply-triage-suggestions
(The page heading is dated September 18, but the URL contains 2025-09-19.)
- OAuth section: "We’re moving OAuth apps to use short-lived access tokens for user-initiated OAuth."
- OAuth section: "Starting October 1st, 2025, all newly created OAuth apps will issue refresh tokens by default."
- OAuth section: "We also added support for the `client_credentials` grant type for apps that use OAuth tokens…"
- Fix (Agents): "We now create an agent session if an agent is mentioned in an issue description, not just a comment"
- Fix (Agents): "Fixed agent panel so it closes on Esc when the input is empty"
- Fix (Agents): "The elicitation status badge in a comment is now removed when there is new activity"
- Fix (Sentry): "The Sentry integration now delegates to agents when choosing an agent as an assignee"
- Improvement (MCP): "Improved support for passing an API key or OAuth token received from an existing Linear integration"
- MCP: "Added support for querying and setting project state and members"
- API: "Removed an agent-delegation backwards-compatibility shim for API and webhooks…"
- API: "Added a new `semanticSearch` query that can search multiple item types at once"
- API: "Allowed issue:create tokens to access issueSubscribe and issueUnsubscribe"
- API: "Improved the process of creating a developer token for an app user with the option to choose which scopes to grant"

**10. September 4, 2025: "Salesforce integration"**
https://linear.app/changelog/2025-09-04-salesforce
- Improvement (Agents): "An agent session will now be created when an issue is delegated to an agent…"
- Improvement (iOS): "Improved visibility of workspace-level agents in the assignee picker"
- Improvement (Mobile): "When an agent replies in a thread, we now show their status in the inbox on mobile apps"
- Improvement (OAuth): "Updating an OAuth application’s avatar will now propagate to all app users associated with the application"
- Fix (PR reviews): "Fixed issue where, when a PR is open and a review is automatically requested from bots…"
- API: "Added `userEmail` as an optional input for `issueSubscribe` and `issueUnsubscribe`"
- API: "Improved response to return a 401 error rather than a 400 for an unauthenticated API request"
- API: "Fixed a bug to include issue in the response payload for `issueAddLabel` and `issueRemoveLabel`"

The page ends with an "Older updates" link, so entries before September 4, 2025 are not included here.

content.text:
I read Linear's changelog index (pages 3–7) and pulled the API, MCP, webhook and OAuth bullets from each 2025 entry, including those listed under improvements and fixes. The entries run from January 23 to December 17, 2025, with no gaps between consecutive pages.

I didn't open each entry page myself. The bullets come from summaries of the index pages. Four items appear in two adjacent entries, so some may be repeated by mistake. I've marked them with †. Check any item you plan to cite against its linked entry.

Each title below links to its entry.

## Dec–Oct 2025
| Date | Title | API/MCP part |
|---|---|---|
| Dec 17 | [Team owners](https://linear.app/changelog/2025-12-17-team-owners) | MCP can add and remove issues from project milestones, returns label group info, accepts project icon and color in `create_project` and `update_project`, and has team filtering on `list_users`. API: issue ID filters accept identifiers, and `AgentSessionEvent` "created" webhooks gain `promptContext`. |
| Dec 11 | [Linear agent for Intercom, Zendesk, Gong](https://linear.app/changelog/2025-12-11-linear-agent-for-intercom-zendesk-gong) | `Team.inviteHash` is deprecated and always returns an empty string. |
| Dec 4 | [OpenAI Codex agent](https://linear.app/changelog/2025-12-04-openai-codex-agent) | `issueUpdate` is allowed with the `issues:create` scope. `Issue.stateHistory` now exposes all workflow-state changes. Projects can be created from a template via API. `ProjectLabel` webhook updates are supported. `includeSubTeams` on `updates` works for custom views with no team ID.† Agent-session webhooks no longer strip image attachments.† A webhook bug for app users added to a team that later became private is fixed.† |
| Nov 20 | [Form templates](https://linear.app/changelog/2025-11-20-form-templates) | The Figma Make connector exposes all Linear MCP tools. Other bullets match Dec 4.† |
| Nov 13 | [Pulse on mobile](https://linear.app/changelog/2025-11-13-pulse-on-mobile) | New security setting controls who can edit workspace-level agent guidance prompts. |
| Oct 28 | [GitHub Copilot agent](https://linear.app/changelog/2025-10-28-github-copilot-agent) | No API or MCP items found. |
| Oct 23 | [Linear agent for Slack](https://linear.app/changelog/2025-10-23-linear-agent-for-slack) | MCP fix for an argument validation error when a team name is passed instead of an ID in label filtering. |
| Oct 16 | [Mobile app redesign](https://linear.app/changelog/2025-10-16-mobile-app-redesign) | OAuth apps can subscribe to webhooks for user authorize and revoke events. Agent sessions are no longer deleted when their comment or issue is deleted. |
| Oct 9 | [Label descriptions and archiving](https://linear.app/changelog/2025-10-09-label-descriptions-and-archiving) | No API or MCP items found. |
| Oct 2 | [Issue discussion summaries](https://linear.app/changelog/2025-10-02-issue-discussion-summaries) | MCP `get_user` accepts "me" or "current_user". OAuth: scope upgrades for existing `app` tokens, clearing denied approval requests, requesting extra scopes, and a fix for the initiative and customer scopes. |

## Sep–Jun 2025
| Date | Title | API/MCP part |
|---|---|---|
| Sep 18 | [Auto-apply triage suggestions](https://linear.app/changelog/2025-09-19-auto-apply-triage-suggestions) | New `semanticSearch` query. OAuth moves to short-lived tokens, with refresh tokens by default for new apps from Oct 1, and `client_credentials` is supported. MCP accepts an existing integration's API key or OAuth token and can query and set project state and members. `issue:create` tokens can use `issueSubscribe` and `issueUnsubscribe`. Developer tokens for app users can choose scopes. An agent-delegation compatibility shim is removed. Agent sessions are created when an agent is mentioned in an issue description. |
| Sep 4 | [Salesforce integration](https://linear.app/changelog/2025-09-04-salesforce) | `userEmail` is an optional input on `issueSubscribe` and `issueUnsubscribe`. Unauthenticated requests return 401 instead of 400. `issueAddLabel` and `issueRemoveLabel` return the issue. OAuth app avatar changes propagate to app users. Delegating an issue creates an agent session. |
| Aug 21 | [Cursor background agents](https://linear.app/changelog/2025-08-21-cursor-agent) | `issueAddLabel` and `issueRemoveLabel` include the issue in the payload.† |
| Aug 14 | [Product Intelligence (Technology Preview)](https://linear.app/changelog/2025-08-14-product-intelligence-technology-preview) | MCP: properties are queried and set by name instead of UUID, `list_users` gets a `query` filter, `list_issue_labels` is paginated, and tool annotations are exposed. API: `issueDelete` returns the deleted issue. `AppUserNotification` webhooks include `oauthClientId`. `initiative` and `customer` scopes work with `actor=app`. API settings show when a key was last used. A webhook delivery bug is fixed. |
| Jul 30 | [Agent Interaction Guidelines and SDK](https://linear.app/changelog/2025-07-30-agent-interaction-guidelines-and-sdk) | MCP `list_cycles` returns more detail. A webhook delivery bug is fixed. |
| Jul 24 | [Dashboards](https://linear.app/changelog/2025-07-24-dashboards) | MCP: `list_issues` is paginated, replying to comment threads works, and truncated text is fixed. |
| Jul 17 | [Email intake for Linear Asks](https://linear.app/changelog/2025-07-17-email-intake-for-asks) | MCP includes `Issue.delegate` and tells the LLM when there are multiple pages. API: issues can be created from the team's default template.† `IssueHistory` gains `fromDelegate` and `toDelegate`. There are two new webhook source IPs, and consecutive webhook changes are delivered faster. |
| Jul 10 | [Sub-initiatives](https://linear.app/changelog/2025-07-10-sub-initiatives) | MCP gains project lead and labels, attachment management, images in descriptions, team lookup by key, cycle filtering and assignment, sub-issue creation, and a My Issues pagination fix. API: default-template issue creation,† cycle `isActive`, `isFuture`, `isPast`, `isNext` and `isPrevious` flags, better content validation, and an OAuth app-user webhook fix. |
| Jun 12 | [Project labels](https://linear.app/changelog/2025-06-12-project-labels) | The API supports basic filters for custom Views. Webhooks fire for comments on project descriptions. A new security setting restricts agent access to full members. |
| Jun 5 | [Asks fields and Triage routing](https://linear.app/changelog/2025-06-05-asks-fields-and-triage-routing) | `Issue` and `Comment` webhooks gain `syncedWith`, and comment webhooks gain `botActor`. `createAsUser` and `displayIconUrl` work for comments in synced Slack threads, and `createAsUser` works with `actor=app` tokens. `User.gitHubUserId` is exposed. The OAuth app details page is improved. |

## May–Jan 2025
| Date | Title | API/MCP part |
|---|---|---|
| May 20 | [Linear for Agents](https://linear.app/changelog/2025-05-20-linear-for-agents) | I found no API bullets, but the entry itself launches the agent platform. |
| May 15 | [Custom feeds in Pulse](https://linear.app/changelog/2025-05-15-custom-feeds-in-pulse) | MCP gains priority, due date, assignee, project and label management, plus the date properties. `User` webhooks include the profile URL. `reactionCreate` accepts emoji and Unicode. OAuth reauthorization wording is clarified. |
| May 1 | [Linear MCP server](https://linear.app/changelog/2025-05-01-mcp) | Launch of the official hosted MCP server. |
| Apr 30 | [Customer Requests on projects](https://linear.app/changelog/2025-04-30-customer-requests-on-projects) | No API or MCP items found. |
| Apr 16 | [Pulse](https://linear.app/changelog/2025-04-16-pulse) | A regular label can no longer be converted into a group label by setting it as another label's `parentId`. |
| Apr 10 | [New search](https://linear.app/changelog/2025-04-10-new-search) | Personal API keys get fine-grained permissions. OAuth supports PKCE without a client secret, and same-workspace apps no longer need approval. `active` is replaced by `userSuspend` and `userUnsuspend`. An issue-with-parent update bug is fixed. |
| Apr 3 | [Collapsed issue history](https://linear.app/changelog/2025-04-03-collapsed-issue-history) | The `iconUrl` on API-created attachments now displays. OAuth integration owners are notified when an issue moves to Triage. |
| Mar 19 | [Collapsible sections](https://linear.app/changelog/2025-03-19-collapsible-sections) | No API or MCP items found. |
| Mar 6 | [Sub-teams](https://linear.app/changelog/2025-03-06-sub-teams) | Customers can be upserted by tier name and loaded by slug ID. Webhooks are sent for initiatives and initiative updates. |
| Feb 13 | [Initiative updates](https://linear.app/changelog/2025-02-13-initiative-updates) | Filters work in the paginated `initiatives` query. Project dependencies expose `relations` and `inverseRelations`, `UserFilter` can filter invited users, and `projectUpdate.isStale` is queryable. Webhooks can subscribe to `Customer` and `CustomerNeed`, and payloads include the issue identifier and URL. Rate-limit details are added for mutation-specific limits. A comments crash is fixed. |
| Jan 23 | [Pull Request reviews (alpha)](https://linear.app/changelog/2025-01-23-pull-request-reviews) | `IssueUpdateInput` gains `addedLabelIds` and `removedLabelIds`, and there is a new `containsIgnoreCaseAndAccent` comparator. `Customer.integration` is added. Removed: `message` from `OrganizationInviteCreateInput`, the ProjectLink resolver, and `Document.contentData` and `ProjectMilestone.descriptionData`. Guests can no longer install OAuth apps. |

Sources: [Linear changelog](https://linear.app/changelog), pages [3](https://linear.app/changelog/page/3), [4](https://linear.app/changelog/page/4), [5](https://linear.app/changelog/page/5), [6](https://linear.app/changelog/page/6).
